compiler.rangeLimits: Same closed object grammar in both modes; vocabulary mode selects all seven global action labels, independently of case input or target. No target-specific constants, patterns or enums.
compiler.source: original authenticated native source from run37053301748; purestdlib conversion, no inference

syntaxPatch.scope: Exclude unescapedJSONcontrolcharacters only. No target values or semantic patterns are introduced.

formatControl.scope: Requests exact named keys in selected order, JSON syntax and declared types only; free strings/integers/booleans/null/list values. No target enums/consts/patterns or target-dependent constraints. Unconstrained prompts unchanged. Schema is provided to sampler, not added to user prompt.
formatControl.scoring: Strict JSON format, declared key/type schema validity and frozen typed-exact target correctness scored independently for both decoders; grammar does not imply valid/correct output when truncated or unsupported.

interpretation: Finite authored global action-vocabulary intervention informed by the previous384 run. Broad-string schema control versus the same seven-action enum for every vocabulary case. Format, schema validity and semantic correctness remain separate. No representative benchmark, protected effect, producer acceptance or independent custody claim.

order.method: SHA256(seed+colon+case.id) ranked32case blocks; rotate four model/cap pairs by sorted-case indexmod4; each pair each position8times; no warmup, repair, examples, retries or retuning.

preparation.scope: Fresh selected transfer, no model/runtime payload cache exemption, within512MiB per declared preparation; previous attempts disclosed separately.

resourceHistory.scope: Previous five preparations disclosed separately. This independently frozen128 preparation adds actual transferred bytes, including failures; no response retry, aggregate reset or model-cache exemption.

resources.cpu: Whole-process CPU delta for each call plus total process CPU during run, including initialization and worker threads; maximum600CPU seconds selected before run.
resources.elapsed: monotonic nanoseconds around each backend call
resources.limits: hard process-group595s TERM plus5s KILL; cumulative preflight prompt/completion maxima; whole-process peakRSS checked after each return and independently held if >1GiB; no RSS hardkill; native late returns retained/held; CPU total checked at preflight and reader; no CPU hardkill and late returns retained/held.
resources.rss: Linux whole-process lifetime peak KiB; shared high-water mark, not per-call allocation
resources.tokens: native llama.cpp prompt/completion counts; preflight counts tokenize exact submitted prompt

rubric.format: single JSON object; no prose or code fences; reject duplicate members and nonfinite values
rubric.quality: object member order and JSON whitespace ignored; recursively exact keys, array order, types and values; bool is not integer

sourceClosure.runnerAuthority: Retained runner bytes must equal the active installed reader bytes; protocol commitment and externally held packet pins are additionally required. Replays use this frozen reader, never execute retained candidate code.

system: Return only the requested JSON object. Do not explain. Use only the supplied record and policy.

taskSelection.selection: Exact sixteen original policy-boundary objects cloned twice with original identity and full object retained. Fixed before inference; no task/drop/target/prompt/grammar changes after output.
taskSelection.targetExposure: Public authored targets; no blinded custody.

unsupported: A declared schema attempt whose selected native interface is unavailable retains started/error NotImplementedError and explicitunsupportedoutcome; no unconstrainedfallback, response retry or inventedscore.
